summary: Verified Gabriel gap_solver formula corrections. All intermediate values (SA(4)=24, SB(15)=106430, digamma(15,47)=103422, SB(3)=-40, digamma(3,5)=-360) match Philippe's exact values. All 4 target gap computations return exact expected values (5-47=-41, 7-23=-15, -7/29=-35, -19/-5=-13). API endpoint /api/gabriel/ask returns computation_type=gap_v2 with correct results.
critical_code_review_comments: gap_solver.py uses Fraction internally but returns via float() cast at boundary - acceptable given integer numerators are always divisible by 64 for these cases, but rounding via int(round(gap_float)) could hide precision issues for larger primes. Consider keeping Fraction end-to-end and asserting exact integer divisibility.
gabriel_service.py detect_computation_request: 'ecart' regex catches ANY 2 numbers, could produce false positives if user mentions unrelated numbers alongside 'ecart'. Low risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gap solver formula is validated exact for target cases. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_gap_calculations.py can serve as regression suite for future gap formula changes.
